title: lidbeckia turbinata
intro: Lidbeckia turbinata, commonly known as the "Turbinated Lidbeckia", is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lidbeckia turbinata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
